title: PET-CT Imaging With PCD-CT
official: Advancing PET-CT Imaging With Photon Counting Detector CT
summary: This pilot study evaluates the clinical utility of photon counting detector computed tomography (PCD-CT) in PET-CT imaging for head and neck cancer. Twenty adult patients undergoing standard-of-care PET-CT will also receive PCD-CT imaging. The study compares image quality and diagnostic confidence between conventional energy-integrating detector CT (EID-CT) and PCD-CT for attenuation correction and anatomical imaging.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 18 years
* Scheduled for or completed standard-of-care PET-CT of head and neck within ≤30 days

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non-diagnostic PET-CT
* Intervening therapy between scans
* Iodinated contrast allergy
* Renal insufficiency (GFR \< 45)
* Pregnancy
* Gross motion artifacts
